# AnberTech

> AnberTech is an independent developer of simple, privacy-friendly mobile apps for iPhone and Android. Each app has its own site with details, support and privacy pages.

## Apps

- [TurnuVolt: Tournament Maker](https://anbertech.github.io/TurnuVolt/): league and knockout tournament organizer for 63 sports and games, plus a free in-browser fixture generator. iPhone and iPad; Android coming soon. Details: https://anbertech.github.io/TurnuVolt/llms.txt
- [Kuafix](https://anbertech.github.io/Kuafix/): appointment app for hair salons and barbers in Turkey. Salons get a booking calendar, statistics and income tracking; customers find a salon, book appointments and try hairstyles with AI. Free on iPhone and Android. Details: https://anbertech.github.io/Kuafix/llms.txt
- [Not Hesaplayıcı / Grade Calculator](https://anbertech.github.io/NotHesaplayici/): course average, the final exam grade needed to pass, and GPA (GANO) tracking. Free, ad-free, offline, no account. iPhone; Android coming soon. Details: https://anbertech.github.io/NotHesaplayici/llms.txt
- [Formal Nöbet Çözücü](https://anbertech.github.io/NobetFormal/): free in-browser tool that builds balanced monthly on-call (nöbet) schedules for hospital doctors around overtime targets, leave and holidays. Turkish. Details: https://anbertech.github.io/NobetFormal/llms.txt
